rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the child's aerial-flight incentive-pay regulations. Both prescribe flight requirements for uniformed-service reserve personnel ordered by competent authority to participate regularly and frequently in aerial flight; both use a cumulative one-, two-, and three-calendar-month schedule and proportional requirements for fractional months. The child substantially updates and expands that same machinery under the Career Compensation Act of 1949. C01 is closely connected because it temporarily continued predecessor regulations under the same statutory provisions, but its displayed text supplies only transitional timing. C10 concerns another allowance under the same Act and shares some regulatory framing, but not the distinctive hazardous-duty machinery.
